C184:
Power-on/reset: wait two vblanks; clear RAM (only $0000-$04FF when the backup-RAM signature $A5/$5A is present, so saved designs survive);
then loop reading the next game state request from $48.
C23B: NMI: sprite DMA, PPU buffer flush, split-screen scroll, timers, joypads, sound, then the per-state game logic.
C2A9:
Dispatch to the current game state's handler through the word table at $C000 (when GameStateActive is set),
otherwise run the state's setup list (tables at $C01C/$C02A/$C033).
C7DE: Menu cursor handler: A = number of items; moves MenuCursor with up/down/select, Start confirms.
D1C7: Draw a metasprite into OAM: $00 X, $01 Y, $02 first tile, $03 size nibbles (columns/rows), $04 OAM pointer low, $0B attributes.
D3C1: Run a PPU write list at ($00): {addr hi, addr lo, count/flags, data...} records ended by a zero byte.
DA26: Per-frame rider movement: accumulate each rider's speed into pixel moves, scroll the world by rider 0's move, shift the others.
E70B: Advance each rider's position in the 64-entry track ring by the pixels it moved.
F844: Sound engine, called every NMI: pulse 1 SFX, pulse 2/triangle SFX, noise SFX, music; clears the request bytes.
